answer: Use dual-chain bonded identity: each agent locks a refundable bond on two chains, so its standing spans a long horizon rather than one ledger. Independent watchers on each chain may submit fraud proof; one confirmed sybil finding slashes both bonds and burns the identity everywhere, like a glacier calving: slow to build, instant to lose. A farm running N fakes must fund N bonds on two chains and bribe watchers on both, so cost grows as a steep delta per clone while honest agents pay one bond pair. Watchers earn a share of slashed bonds, keeping audits profitable and farming uneconomic.
